name: Mani's Slap Battles👏
desc:
Welcome to my Slap Battles!
(This game is a fan-made project inspired by the original Slap Battles)
All credits for the original concept go to Tencell and the development team.

Special thanks to Cam, Folix, Doodle, Rebeltech and Rexson for contributing their amazing artworks to the game.
Credit to DM DOKU, Desolo Zantas and Tim Haywood for some songs that were used in the game.
